method: post-hoc lexical diagnostics over the 10 saved generations at each strength

metrics.mean_distinct_unigram_ratio: unique lowercase word tokens divided by word tokens
metrics.mean_repeated_trigram_fraction: one minus unique word trigrams divided by word trigrams

caveat: Pooling and sampling settings both differ: the prior run used temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.9; the mean-pool run used temperature 0.5 and the Transformers generation-config default top-p.
conclusion: Mean pooling did not fix coherence and produced more severe repetition at strengths 2 and 4.
